_doc: Claude Desktop reads only local (stdio) servers from claude_desktop_config.json. It does not connect to a remote URL in that file. To use the hosted server directly, open Customize > Connectors (on Team and Enterprise plans, an Owner adds it under Organization settings > Connectors), click + Add, choose Add custom connector, and enter https://emem.dev/mcp. To use the config file instead, paste the entry below. It runs the mcp-remote bridge from npm, so Node.js must be installed. File locations: macOS ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Linux ~/.config/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json, Windows %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json. Restart Claude Desktop after you save the file.
